pageSubtitle: Share your magical work with the Spellful community. Creator status is reviewed by our team and grants a Verified Creator badge on your profile.
eligibilityDesc: You must have an active Spellful account with a username. Applications are reviewed privately — your submission is never posted publicly. We aim to review applications within 7–14 days.
accountTypeCreatorDesc: Individual creators, artists, practitioners, and educators sharing their craft.
accountTypeOrgDesc: Shops, studios, collectives, and organizations with a public presence.
contactEmailNote: Used only for review correspondence. Not shown publicly.
socialsNote: All optional. Provide at least one social handle or work sample so we can verify your work.
workDescLabel: Describe your work, products, services, or content
workDescPlaceholder: Tell us about what you create, who it's for, and what makes it unique…
samplesNote: Paste links to your work, portfolio, shop, or social posts. If you don't have social media, describe where your work can be found.
reasonLabel: Why are you applying for Creator status?
reasonPlaceholder: Tell us what you hope to share with the Spellful community and how Creator status would support your work…
notesPlaceholder: Anything else you'd like us to know…
privacyDesc: Your application and contact details are visible only to you and authorized Spellful reviewers. They will never be posted publicly, shared with other members, or used for marketing.

successDesc: Your application is now under review. We'll notify you in-app when a decision is made. Keep an eye on your notifications.
